producer_script: Script do Record Producer, de mapeamento. Lê o registro de x_nasm_hr_profile indicado pela variável 'employee' e grava o campo 'user' desse perfil em current.requested_for, definindo o solicitante do caso. Grava também current.item com o sysparm_id vindo da URL, que é o sys_id do próprio record producer — é esse campo que as triggers de flow usam para identificar de qual item o registro veio.

variaveis.name: v_introduction
variaveis.question_text:
It is with pride that we can state that Nossaprev's mission goes far beyond supplementing its employees' retirement income. It involves respect for the work and dedication of each professional who contributes to the success of the Natura &Co Group today and in the future.
Nossaprev's objective is to manage one of the main Benefits that the Natura &Co group offers its employees.
Nossaprev has been operating for more than 24 years to guarantee its Participants supplementary pension benefits to Social Security (INSS), in order to contribute to the quality of life of these employees and their beneficiaries.
Come join!

variaveis.question_text: Redemptions taxed at 15% at source for any amount, as an advance tax due on the Annual Adjustment Statement. Benefits will be taxed according to the progressive table. variaveis.question_text: I declare, in compliance with Previc Normative Instruction No. 34, of 10/28/2020, which deals with the procedures to be adopted by Closed Supplementary Pension Entities to monitor operations carried out by politically exposed persons, aiming to curb "laundering" crimes or concealment of assets, rights and values, the information that follows:
choices: I DO NOT fit the definition adopted for people considered politically exposed; [=i_do_not_fit_the_definition_adopted_for_people_considered_politically_exposed]
I FIT THE definition adopted for people considered politically exposed. [=i_fit_the_definition_adopted_for_people_considered_politically_exposed]

variaveis.name: v_for_the_purposes_of_the_above_information
variaveis.question_text:
For the purposes of the above information, I declare that I am aware that a politically exposed person means the public agent who performs or has performed, in the last five years, in Brazil or in a country, territory or foreign dependency, position, job or relevant public function, as well as their representatives, family members and other people of your close relationship.
For the purposes of Normative Instruction No. 34/2020, relatives in the direct line, up to the first degree, spouse, partner, partner, stepson and stepdaughter are considered family members.

variaveis.name: v_lgpd_considering_the_provisions_of_law
variaveis.question_text:
GDPR
Considering the provisions of Law 13.709/2018 (General Law for the Protection of Personal Data - LGPD), I express my consent to the processing of personal data by Nossaprev, especially: registration information (name, date of birth, marital status, RG, CPF, address), family composition, dependents, employer, salary, current account, social security information, taxes and income report. In addition to the previous items, any others necessary for the implementation of the provisions set forth in the Regulation of the Natura &Co Group Benefit Plan and their specific purposes are included, as well as for receiving information by electronic and physical means regarding the benefits, services and information offered by Nossaprev.

primeira_analise.nome: Aderir, alterar ou não aderir à previdência privada (Nossaprev)
primeira_analise.short_description: Faça adesão, altere sua contribuição ou declare que não quer participar do plano de previdência privada Nossaprev.
primeira_analise.description: Use para aderir ao plano de previdência privada Nossaprev do Grupo Natura &Co, alterar o percentual de contribuição básica ou adicional, escolher perfil de investimento e regime de tributação, ou declarar que não quer participar do plano. O formulário exige leitura dos termos e assinatura eletrônica. Não use para resgate ou portabilidade do saldo, nem para mudar o perfil de investimento fora de junho e dezembro (isso é feito no site da Nossaprev).
frases_exemplo: Como aumento minha contribuição na Nossaprev?
Não quero participar do plano de previdência
